The exact full law is Pr[S=s,Y=y]=2^-n mu(y-s) for fixed integral J and independent S,G. Supports of different binary s are disjoint precisely when no ternary difference lies in J. Positive-mass branches have a unique s; zero branches arbitrary. This is proof-only Y=G+S, not a public transcript claim; no Gaussian marginal or pairwise-independence inference.
